Closing the Distance Between Population Data and Decisions

2026-08-15 Esri Esri, UNFPA, population data, ArcGIS, humanitarian, hackathon, geospatial intelligence, dashboards
Read the source article

Quick summary

The UN Population Fund launched the PopIntel Hackathon in Nairobi with Esri as geospatial technology partner, bringing together experts to create tools that turn scattered population data into actionable intelligence for humanitarian decision-making.

Key takeaways

  • UNFPA launched the Population Intelligence Hackathon in Nairobi, bringing together experts from public health, population modeling, AI, and geospatial technology
  • Esri serves as geospatial technology partner, providing ArcGIS Online, Living Atlas, Experience Builder, Dashboards, and Instant Apps
  • The hackathon has three tracks: Climate Pulse (climate-demographic risk), Safe Futures (health and gender-based violence prevention), and Trust Layer (country validation and responsible AI)
  • Participants use ArcGIS to combine population, climate, health, mobility, and risk layers into maps, dashboards, and applications at district and country scale
  • The goal is to shorten the path from population data to decisions, enabling decision-makers to see where risk is forming and who is exposed
